name: issue-triage
prompt: GitHub issue #{issue.number} '{issue.title}' opened by {issue.user.login}. Classify per business/sops/product/bug-triage.md: bug | feature-request | docs | wontfix. If bug: file a Linear issue with severity and link both ways. If feature-request: add to Notion 'Feedback' DB with the verbatim quote and use case. If docs: open a Notion docs task. If wontfix: post the rationale as a GitHub comment. Post a one-line summary to #product with the classification.
